dispatch: Session 324 swept the vault's verification gates and found twelve that no runner ever called — including three that had gone quietly stale behind a green three-hundred-nineteen-of-three-hundred-nineteen reading. The changelog, the AI-readable map, and the public statistics surface are current again, with seven scheduled publishers now re-deriving what they touch instead of drifting. The full suite stands sealed at three hundred twenty-seven of three hundred twenty-seven, and a new structural check ensures no future gate goes unmeasured.
